description: Coupled state-variable dynamics and fractal coherence tracking. Two independent models: ContinuumState/step_continuum for 6-variable nonlinear discrete-time dynamics, and FractalEngine/FractalState for cycle-based coherence tracking with SHA-256 determinism.
function: Nonlinear continuum state dynamics (ContinuumState + step_continuum), fractal coherence tracking (FractalState + FractalEngine)

inputs.name: noise_std
inputs.description: Gaussian noise standard deviation for step_continuum (default 0.002)

inputs.name: rng
inputs.description: RNG instance for reproducible steps in step_continuum

inputs.name: n_steps
inputs.description: Number of discrete time steps for run_continuum

inputs.name: history_size
inputs.description: Deque size for FractalEngine coherence history (default 100)

outputs.name: ContinuumState
outputs.description: 6-variable state: psi, F, S, C, R, Q with to_dict()

outputs.name: energy
outputs.description: Derived energy Q = (F * psi) / (1 + S) * R

outputs.name: step_continuum
outputs.description: Next state after one discrete time step

outputs.name: FractalState
outputs.description: coherence, entropy, resonance_hz, drift with to_dict()

outputs.name: FractalEngine.get_statistics
outputs.description: mean, std, min, max of coherence history

public_api.name: ContinuumState
public_api.description: 6-variable coupled state dataclass. Fields: psi (coherence), F (fusion), S (entropy), C (chaos), R (resonance Hz), Q (energy). Method: to_dict() -> Dict[str, float]

public_api.name: energy
public_api.description: Compute derived energy Q = (F * psi) / (1 + S) * R

public_api.name: step_continuum
public_api.description: Advance the continuum state by one discrete time step with Gaussian noise. All variables clamped to [0,1] except R and Q.

public_api.name: run_continuum
public_api.signature: run_continuum(n_steps: int, initial=None, *, noise_std=0.002, seed=None) -> List[Dict]
public_api.description: Run the continuum dynamics for n_steps. Returns list of n_steps+1 state dicts (initial state included).

public_api.name: FractalState
public_api.description: Fractal coherence state dataclass. Fields: coherence, entropy, resonance_hz, drift. Method: to_dict() -> Dict[str, float]

public_api.name: FractalEngine
public_api.description: Cycle-based fractal coherence tracker. Uses SHA-256 determinism plus time-based sine modulation. Pure stdlib, no external dependencies.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.compute_metrics
public_api.description: Compute fractal metrics for the next cycle step. Advances cycle_count.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.get_state
public_api.description: Return the most recently computed FractalState.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.get_history
public_api.description: Return the full coherence history as a list.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.get_statistics
public_api.description: Return mean, std, min, max of the coherence history.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.is_stable
public_api.description: Return True if drift < drift_threshold and coherence > coherence_threshold.

public_api.name: FractalEngine.reset
public_api.description: Reset coherence history, state, and cycle_count to initial values.
